subject: Air freight quote request – PVG and BKK
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote the cheapest air freight option for each of the following shipments?

1. To PVG (Shanghai, CN): machine parts, 2 pieces, gross weight 1972 kg, volume 15.00 cbm.
2. To BKK (Bangkok, TH): furniture samples, 4 pieces, gross weight 690 kg, volume 4.63 cbm.

Both shipments are ready for pickup on 2026-11-26 at our site in 61017 (Bad Homburg), Germany. Please arrange the truck transport from our site to the airport and include it in your quote.

Please send both quotes in the same reply, with a separate all-in price in EUR for each shipment, not one combined price.

Thank you.

Viele Gruesse / Many greetings
Deniz Yilmaz
Rheintal Elektronik GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer requests separate all-in air freight quotes for two new shipments.
